NOS-DOS Package Manager (NPKG)
==============================

OVERVIEW
--------
NPKG downloads, installs, and removes DOS software packages from the
NOS-DOS repository. Packages are defined by .npkg files that specify
where to download the archive, how to extract it, and what to configure.

NPKG requires an active network connection (run NNET DHCP first).
Archives are downloaded from archive.org and other public sources.

QUICK REFERENCE
---------------
  NPKG UPDATE              Refresh package index
  NPKG SEARCH [term]       Find packages
  NPKG INSTALL [id]        Install a package
  NPKG REMOVE [id]         Remove a package
  NPKG LIST                Show installed packages
  NPKG INFO [id]           Show package details
  NPKG PROFILE [id]        Show hardware requirements

INSTALLATION DETAILS
--------------------
When you run NPKG INSTALL [id]:

  1. NPKG downloads the package index if not cached.
  2. The package definition (.npkg file) is fetched from the repository.
  3. The archive (ZIP/ARJ) is downloaded from the source URL.
     - Up to 3 fallback URLs are tried.
     - 3 retry attempts per URL with 3-second back-off.
     - Files under 1 KB are rejected as error pages.
  4. The archive is extracted to the InstallDir (e.g. C:\APPS\GALAXY).
  5. POST-INSTALL commands run (echo instructions, create directories).
  6. If SetPath=yes, InstallDir is appended to AUTOEXEC.BAT PATH.
  7. If the package has a [LAUNCHER] section, it is added to LAUNCHER.CFG
     so the application appears in the NOS-SHELL F9 launcher.
  8. Games with a [GAME] section are launched via NOSPLAY automatically.

REMOVING PACKAGES
-----------------
  NPKG REMOVE [id]

  This will:
  - Show the install directory and ask for confirmation.
  - Run [REMOVE] batch commands (typically DELTREE /Y C:\APPS\name).
  - Remove the AUTOEXEC.BAT block added at install time.
  - Remove the launcher entry from LAUNCHER.CFG.
  - Deregister from INSTALLED.DB.

COMMERCIAL SOFTWARE NOTE
------------------------
Commercial packages (marked "commercial" in the license field) require
a valid purchased copy. NPKG only downloads from public archive.org
sources that host software legally. You are responsible for ensuring
you have the appropriate licence for any commercial software installed.

Shareware and freeware packages have no such restrictions.

ADDING YOUR OWN PACKAGES
------------------------
See CONTRIBUTING.TXT (on GitHub) for the full .npkg format reference.
Briefly: create a file with the same structure as the packages in
C:\NOS\NPKG\DEFS\ and run NPKG INSTALL with the local .npkg path.

NETWORK TROUBLESHOOTING
-----------------------
If downloads fail:
  - Run NNET STATUS to verify you have an IP address.
  - Run NNET DHCP if no IP is shown.
  - archive.org may throttle requests -- wait 1-2 minutes and retry.
  - Try NPKG INSTALL again; NPKG retries each URL 3 times.
  - Check that MTCP.CFG exists: TYPE C:\NOS\SYSTEM\MTCP.CFG
